caption: When you're flat out on a job, your phone keeps lighting up and you can't answer it. Every unanswered message is someone waiting. If a helper replied for you while your hands were full, in your voice, what would that free up? Comment AGENT below.

slides.headline: Your hands are full. Your phone isn't.
You're mid-job.
slides.body: Under a sink, on a roof, with a client in the chair. You can't pick up.

slides.headline: The phone keeps lighting up.
slides.body: Enquiries, questions, someone asking if you're free this week.

slides.headline: Each one is a person waiting.
slides.body: They want a quick answer. If it doesn't come, they ask someone else.

slides.headline: What if a helper replied for you?
slides.body: A friendly answer straight away. In your voice. While you keep working.

slides.headline: You finish the job. Then you check in.
slides.body: Anything tricky is waiting for you, everything else is already handled.

beats.text: Your hands are full. Your phone isn't.
You're mid-job and can't pick up.
Every message is a person waiting for an answer.
What if a helper replied for you?
Straight away. In your voice. While you keep working.
beats.bubble: Hi! Thanks for your message. What day suits you?
